'''Verus Carbinol''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garnib]]. He hated the posting on the arctic world and spent the majority of his time in office alone in his 47-room oceanside mansion, enjoying the wealth he was passively earning from unopposed taxes. [[Garnib Station]], the planet's only Imperial base, was located next to his mansion.
